title: Cloudboy's Vanilla Pack
description: A vanilla pack with all the performance and quality-of-life mods you need, plus Shaders and Litematica! Essential mod is also included, Perfect for a building server with your friends😁
body:
A Vanilla pack that balances performance mods from Fabulously Optimized with a lot of quality of life to enhance your vanilla experience and make sure you have stable performance on all devices! Shaders are included if you want to make your game more pretty, as well as some nice texture packs and Litematica to help with building!

Essential mod is also included so you can easily play with your friends(●'◡'●)

This pack is perfect for players who just want a simple vanilla experience with good performance while also adding things that make the experience easier for you.
